title: Danger No Longer Exists or Attacker Disabled

source.release: 2026 Criminal Jury Instructions (as adopted by the Judicial Council, February 2026)

body: The right to use force in (self-defense/[or] defense of another) continues only as long as the danger exists or reasonably appears to exist. [When the attacker (withdraws/[or] no longer appears capable of inflicting any injury), then the right to use force ends.]

bench_notes.text: The court may give this instruction on request when supported by the evidence. (See *People v. Martin* (1980) 101 Cal.App.3d 1000, 1010 [162 Cal.Rptr. 133].)

authority.text: • Instructional Requirements. See *People v. Keys* (1944) 62 Cal.App.2d 903, 916 [145 P.2d 589]; *People v. Perez* (1970) 12 Cal.App.3d 232, 236 [90 Cal.Rptr. 521].
